preview.instruction:
Hello everyone! Welcome to Teneriffe Athletic Club x TrainHeroic! This will be the app we will use to track our weights and workouts, while also allowing you to complete the workout by yourself if you ever can't make a class. 

If you have any questions please come and ask anytime during the class, we will be more than happy to assist.

Key Points:
1. Please enter your weights and reps for each exercise. This is how we track your weekly progress.
2. There are suggested swaps for exercises
3. Some compounds are based on percentage so please enter in your 1 or 3 rep maxes you did in the past 2 weeks for these. It will then workout your training max 
4. Reps in reserve (RIR) is commonly used. This is how many reps you have left before you hit failure. I will make a video to further explain the use of RIR for training intensity.seperate video for you all on training intensity 
5. Ask questions! Please make use of as coaches
6. Please make sure you book into the class! Thankyou

workoutSetExercises.instruction: The warm up will typically be 2-3 rounds of these exercises based on a warm up time cap. Complete as many rounds as you can in the given warm up time

workoutSetExercises.title: Hanging Scap Retracts
workoutSetExercises.instruction:

workoutSetExercises.title: Medball Thoracic Opener
workoutSetExercises.instruction:

Feel free to use a lighter weight or dumbbells if the 5kg plate feels too hard. Each rep should get progressively easier and you should be able to reach closer and closer to the ground.

preview.title: Full Body - W3D3
preview.instruction:
Hello everyone! Welcome to week 3 of this training block! 

If you have any questions please come and ask anytime during the class, we will be more than happy to assist.

Key Points:
1. Please enter your weights and reps for each exercise. This is how we track your weekly progress.
2. There are suggested swaps for exercises
3. Some compounds are based on percentage so please enter in your 1 or 3 rep maxes you did in the past 2 weeks for these. It will then workout your training max 
4. Reps in reserve (RIR) is commonly used. This is how many reps you have left before you hit failure. I will make a video to further explain the use of RIR for training intensity.seperate video for you all on training intensity 
5. Ask questions! Please make use of as coaches
6. Please make sure you book into the class! Thankyou
